title: Add provider availability cooldown state
prompt: Continue Phase 10 by adding durable provider availability/cooldown models and a small atomic store. Represent quota pause resume_after, temporary backoff, unauthorized state, and healthy availability without credentials or provider session IDs. Add pure evaluation against an injected timezone-aware now and atomic human-readable JSON persistence with tests for due/not-due cooldowns, invalid timestamps, round-trip, and secret rejection.
